title: Orchestrate credential adapters and typed stream shims across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: This PR harmonizes credential adapter abstractions and introduces a small, typed shim layer for streaming consumers across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. Motivation: multiple downstream teams and platform demos relied on slightly different credential lifecycle hooks and stream iterator ergonomics; this leads to duplicated adapter code and subtle reauth/retry behavior mismatches. Work: - Introduce a lightweight CredentialAdapter contract and a minimal session-priming helper used by all three SDKs. The adapter surface is intentionally small: fetch(), refresh_hint(), and close() so it can work with KMS/HSM-backed stores as well as ephemeral token services. - Add typed StreamShim helpers (py: StreamIteratorShim, ts: streamShim, go: StreamCursorShim) that centralize resume semantics, graceful drain on cancel, and expose a small backoff-presets hint for SDK callers. - Add a RetryPreset enum and small compat shim that maps platform policies to SDK-friendly retry profiles. - Keep breaking changes to a minimum: the previous auth helpers are deprecated with warnings and adapter factories provided to bridge existing callsites. - Version bumps for SDK packages: python 1.13.0, typescript 2.6.0, go 1.5.0 to capture new helpers and typed exports. This single string contains the full description, checklist and testing notes. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-4121) - [x] Cross-SDK API alignment meeting held 2026-01-30 - [x] Unit tests added for adapter edge-cases - [x] End-to-end sample updated (chat-demo/credential-adapter) - [x] Docs updated with migration notes - [x] Version bumps wired into packaging scripts Migration notes: existing clients using auth helpers should call bridge_factory() to avoid any immediate changes; see docs/sdk/migration/cred-adaptor.md. Monitoring: added telemetry hooks for adapter refresh latency and shim resume failures (instrumentation key: cred.adapter.latency).

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice consolidation — can we keep the public surface minimal? Suggest making refresh_hint optional on the interface to support legacy token stores.
Maya Patel (author): Agreed, made refresh_hint optional and added a legacy bridge_factory that implements a no-op hint. Updated unit tests to cover both code paths.
Priya Singh: In TS shim, observed a small race on stream close + reauth; please add a deterministic test or use an atomic flag.
Maya Patel (author): Added an atomic close guard and a focused unit test (adapter.spec.ts::handles-close-during-refresh).
Alex Romero: CI flaked on go integration once; re-run passes. Consider adding a short delay in the integration harness to stabilize ephemeral token endpoint in CI.

notes_on_backward_compat: No breaking changes forced; deprecated helpers print a single-time warning. Bridge factories included to ease migration. Consumers can opt-in to new typed shims immediately.
release_notes: - Introduce CredentialAdapter interface across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. - Add typed StreamShim helpers to centralize resume and cancel semantics. - Add RetryPreset mapping to unify retry/reauth behavior across SDKs. - Deprecate old auth helpers; provide bridge_factory for migration. - Bumped SDK versions: python->1.13.0, typescript->2.6.0, go->1.5.0.
